lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents per km² of land, from NUTS 3 population on 1 January 2025 and land area; a hex shows the area-weighted mean of the regions under its sample points.

lenses.name: Growth
lenses.description: Population change between 1 January 2021 and 1 January 2025, NUTS 3 regions.

lenses.name: Median age
lenses.description: Median age of residents, NUTS 3 regions (demo_r_pjanind3).

lenses.name: Aged 65+
lenses.unit: share of residents aged 65 or over
lenses.description: Share of the population aged 65 or over, NUTS 3 regions (demo_r_pjangrp3).

lenses.name: Born abroad
lenses.unit: share of residents 15–74 born in another country
lenses.description: People aged 15–74 born outside the country they live in (Labour Force Survey, lfst_r_lfsd2pwc).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: GDP per person
lenses.description: GDP at current market prices divided by population, NUTS 3. Counts output where people work, so commuter hubs (Luxembourg, city centres) score far above their surroundings.

lenses.name: GDP per person (PPS)
lenses.description: GDP per inhabitant in purchasing power standards (prices adjusted between countries), NUTS 3.

lenses.name: Income
lenses.unit: household disposable income per person, PPS
lenses.description: Net disposable income of private households per inhabitant, in purchasing power standards (nama_10r_2hhinc).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.description: Unemployed as a share of the labour force aged 15–74 (lfst_r_lfu3rt).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.unit: share at risk of poverty or social exclusion
lenses.description: People at risk of poverty or social exclusion (AROPE), EU-SILC (ilc_peps11n). Some countries publish only NUTS 1 or national values.
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Degrees
lenses.description: Share of adults aged 25–64 with tertiary education, ISCED 5–8 (edat_lfse_04).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: R&D
lenses.description: Gross domestic expenditure on research and development as a percentage of GDP (rd_e_gerdreg).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: High-tech jobs
lenses.unit: share of jobs in high-tech sectors
lenses.description: Employment in high-technology manufacturing and knowledge-intensive high-tech services (htec_emp_reg2).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Broadband
lenses.description: Households with a broadband internet connection (isoc_r_broad_h; latest regional year, 2021).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Life expectancy
lenses.description: Life expectancy at birth (demo_r_mlifexp).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Tourism
lenses.unit: tourist nights per resident per year
lenses.description: Nights spent at hotels, holiday homes and campsites per resident (tour_occ_nin2).
lenses.note: Published for NUTS 2 regions: every NUTS 3 region inside one shares its value.

lenses.name: Farm jobs
lenses.unit: share of jobs in agriculture, forestry & fishing
lenses.description: Agriculture, forestry & fishing (NACE A) as a share of all jobs, NUTS 3.

lenses.name: Factory jobs
lenses.description: Manufacturing (NACE C) as a share of all jobs, NUTS 3. Where a country publishes only broader groups, the split follows the parent region.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Tree cover share of the hex’s land samples (ESA WorldCover 2021).

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Cropland plus lowland grassland (mostly pasture and meadows) share of the hex’s land samples (ESA WorldCover 2021).

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Built-up share of the hex’s land samples (ESA WorldCover 2021, 10 m buildings and roads read at ~300 m).

lenses.name: Elevation
lenses.description: Mean elevation of the hex’s land samples (AWS Terrain Tiles: SRTM, EU-DEM and others).
